questions.question: Fedin’s cited anecdote and the illustration concern a cylinder section, while the explanatory paragraph treats the carrot as a cone and says that changing the angle can yield other conic sections. Decide whether to align the geometry with the source: an oblique plane through a circular cylinder gives an ellipse, whereas cone sections require specifying the plane’s position relative to the cone.
